review_candidates.title: Intermediate Backend Engineer (Remote, Vietnam)
review_candidates.description: Who We Are & How We Work We're on a mission to make employment easier and more valuable for everyone. Our Employment Operating System brings hiring, HR, payroll and benefits into one platform, supporting over 350,000 businesses and 2.5 million employees worldwide. We're a Mission First, Remote First and AI First company, guided by our values and a commitment to high performance. Our Engineering team follows a one problem, one engineer approach. With AI coding agents at the core of how we build, Engineers own problems end-to-end, from understanding customer needs and designing solutions to delivering them into production. We start with the smallest working solution and continuously improve it, giving Engineers the autonomy to make decisions and create meaningful product impact. The Role As an Intermediate Backend Engineer, you'll build and improve the systems behind our Employment Operating System, delivering reliable solutions that make a difference for millions of users. We're looking for someone with solid backend expertise, a problem-solving mindset and a passion for building great products, who's ready to take ownership and grow in an AI-first engineering environment. What You'll Do Own product problems end-to-end, from understanding requirements and designing solutions to development, testing and production deployment. Build and maintain reliable backend services, RESTful APIs and integrations. Solve technical challenges, improve application performance and deliver practical, maintainable solutions. Leverage AI coding agents to accelerate development while maintaining code quality. Make thoughtful technical decisions, applying sound engineering practices and seeking input when tackling unfamiliar challenges. Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams, contribute to technical discussions and continuously improve your skills.. What We're Looking For Solid software engineering experience, typically 5+ years, with proven backend development experience in production environments. Strong proficiency in at least one backend language, such as Ruby, Python, Java, PHP or JavaScript/TypeScript. Solid fundamentals in RESTful APIs, databases, automated testing and software engineering best practices. Good problem-solving skills and product thinking, with the ability to independently deliver well-defined solutions and seek guidance when needed. An AI-first mindset, with experience or a strong willingness to use AI coding agents to improve software delivery. Good English communication skills, a proactive approach and the ability to thrive in a global, remote-first team. We primarily build our applications using Ruby. Ruby experience isn't required, and we'll support you in developing the necessary skills when you join. You'll also have opportunities to expand your expertise across the full stack. What We Can Offer At Employment Hero, we don’t just talk about a better way to work. We live it. Joining Employment Hero Means You’ll Work in a remote-first environment, giving you the autonomy to do your best work while delivering meaningful outcomes. Be trusted to own your work, make decisions, and have a real impact from day one. Access cutting-edge AI tools and technology that help you move faster, think bigger, and amplify your expertise. Surround yourself with ambitious, high-performing teammates who will challenge, support and inspire you to do the best work of your career. Own ESOP (Employee Share Options) in one of the world’s fastest-growing technology companies, so you can share in the value you help create. Enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including generous parental leave, subsidised egg freezing, a home office allowance, and outstanding learning and development opportunities to support your growth. Connect with colleagues from around the world at our Annual Global Gathering. We’ve celebrated together in Thailand, Vietnam, Bali and Dubai, Australia and can’t wait to meet in Singapore, in September 2027. These tools do not replace human judgment and the final hiring decision sits with our team. We verify candidate identity and location as part of our hiring process. At Employment Hero, we are committed to safeguarding the privacy of your application data. review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer – Infor Varial Payroll
review_candidates.description: Department: Development Location: Hamburg Description Arbeitsort: Deutschland - Infor Büro oder Home-Office Wir suchen einen Senior Software Engineer (m/w/d) , der hochwertige Softwarelösungen für unsere Infor Varial Payroll-Lösung konzipiert, entwickelt und bereitstellt. Als wichtiges Mitglied unseres agilen Engineering-Teams treiben Sie technische Exzellenz voran, unterstützen und begleiten weniger erfahrene Entwickler:innen und gestalten die Weiterentwicklung unserer Infor Varial Payroll-Anwendung aktiv mit. Infor Varial Payroll (https://varial.de) ist eine etablierte, marktführende Lösung, die fundierte Expertise in der Entgeltabrechnung, umfassende HR-Funktionalitäten, eine flexible Architektur und kontinuierliche Innovation miteinander verbindet. Damit unterstützt sie Unternehmen dabei, ihre Personalprozesse effizient und gesetzeskonform zu steuern. Aufgabenschwerpunkte Sie übernehmen eine führende Rolle bei der Konzeption, Entwicklung und Bereitstellung unserer Infor Varial Payroll-Lösung. Sie stellen eine gesetzeskonforme, zuverlässige und kontinuierlich aktualisierte Entgeltabrechnung sicher, die den komplexen Anforderungen des deutschen Steuer-, Sozialversicherungs- und Arbeitsrechts entspricht. Sie wirken an einer integrierten Lösung mit, die Entgeltabrechnung, Personaladministration, Employee Self-Service und digitales Personalmanagement miteinander verbindet. Sie arbeiten eng mit Product Management, UX Design und Quality Assurance zusammen, um geschäftskritische Funktionen zu entwickeln und bereitzustellen. Sie schreiben sauberen, effizienten und wartbaren Code gemäß unseren Varial Best Practices. Sie beteiligen sich aktiv an Code Reviews, Architekturentscheidungen und der Planung der technischen Roadmap. Sie treiben Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Performance, Zuverlässigkeit und Skalierbarkeit unserer Software voran. Sie verfolgen aktuelle und neue Technologien und bewerten deren Einsatzmöglichkeiten für unsere Lösungen. Sie leben die Infor-Werte Geschwindigkeit, Innovation und Zusammenarbeit im Arbeitsalltag. Anforderungen Erfahrung mit den gesetzlichen und regulatorischen Anforderungen der deutschen Entgeltabrechnung. Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Payroll-, HR- oder anderen geschäftskritischen Enterprise-Anwendungen. Verständnis der deutschen Entgeltabrechnungsprozesse, einschließlich Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung, steuerrechtlicher Vorgaben, Sozialversicherungsanforderungen und gesetzlicher Meldepflichten. Kenntnisse der deutschen Melde- und elektronischen Kommunikationsverfahren im Payroll-Umfeld, einschließlich des regulatorischen Datenaustauschs mit Sozialversicherungsträgern, Finanzbehörden und anderen öffentlichen Stellen. Erfahrung mit für unseren Technologie-Stack relevanten Programmiersprachen und Technologien, beispielsweise Java, Vaadin, C++ und SQL. Fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und in der Konzeption von Business-Anwendungen. Erfahrung mit agilen Entwicklungsmethoden sowie CI/CD-Praktiken. Wünschenswerte Qualifikationen Erfahrung mit DevOps-Toolchains und DevOps-Praktiken. Erfahrung im Mentoring, Coaching und in der fachlichen Weiterentwicklung von Softwareentwickler:innen. About Infor Infor is where ambition meets impact. Join a global community of bold thinkers and innovators, where your expertise doesn't just solve problems. it shapes industries, unlocks opportunities, and creates real-world impact for billions of people. At Infor, you're not just building a career. you're helping to build what's next. Infor is a global leader in business cloud software products for companies in industry specific markets. Infor builds complete industry suites in the cloud and efficiently deploys technology that puts the user experience first, leverages data science, and integrates easily into existing systems. Over 60,000 organizations worldwide rely on Infor to help overcome market disruptions and achieve business-wide digital transformation. For more information visit www.infor.com Our Values At Infor, we strive for an environment that is founded on a business philosophy called Principle Based Management™ (PBM™) and eight Guiding Principles: integrity, stewardship & compliance, transformation, principled entrepreneurship, knowledge, humility, respect, self-actualization. We have a relentless commitment to a culture based on PBM™. Informed by the principles that allow a free and open society to flourish, PBM™ prepares individuals to innovate, improve, and transform while fostering a healthy, growing organization that creates long-term value for its clients and supporters and fulfillment for its employees.
